newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka suspends trading in Kotagala.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka suspends trading in Kotagala.

text.p: Trading in shares of Kotagala Plantations Ltd was suspended by the Colombo Stock Exchange (CSE) on Friday, brokers said, but it was not immediately clear what had prompted the decision.
CSE officials were not available for comment.
"All we know is that trading was suspended on Friday morning," said one broker, who declined to be identified.
"We are all waiting to know for how long the share will be suspended and the reason for the action," he added.
Kotagala Plantations is a member of the Lankem Ceylon group. Shares of Kotagala Plantations were last traded at 37.50 on June 12.
